selection.policy: Geometry and signal support only; Full32 is used as an expected-blur signal. B0/B1 quality, fallback error, and confirmatory thresholds are not consulted.

Q1_Q6.reason: Largest measured Full32/source interior far signal (0.03631934642940017) with 176250 pixels; quality metrics are not used.

Q2_Q7.reason: Strong Full32/source interior far signal (0.02773432285804044) with 3903 reconstructed-depth edge pixels and 65 valid signed-boundary pairs; fallback and profile quality remain unexamined.

Q3_Q4.reason: The selected 5,200 mm full-film state has 540 valid signed pairs and interior Full32/source signal 0.004028962953638875. The 8,890 mm full-film alternatives have more signed pairs (5213 and 5851) and about 0.209 boundary contrast, but their canonical façade point is only 0.000517 mm from focus and their interior Full32/source signal is about 0.000086 (about 47x weaker). The 8,890 mm 4x-crop alternative has 4834 signed pairs and 0.2438503498609138 boundary contrast, but zero reconstructed-depth edge pixels and an interior Full32/source signal of 0.000097. Q3 therefore prioritizes canonical sign separation, measurable expected blur and depth-edge support over maximum raster pair count; no B0/B1 quality score is used for selection. Canonical signs are foreground -0.545020 mm, midground -0.024282 mm, façade 0.330761 mm, and far 0.399559 mm. Raster point correspondence remains separately reported.

Q5.reason: Largest uncapped raster radius observed in the mounted app catalog (6.294583538385827px); paired stress-cap confirmation is still required.

limitations: Exploratory Full32 outputs are finite-sample expected-blur signals, not photographic ground truth or B1 quality results.
Canonical point CoC is computed from registered scene geometry; raster CoC and depth remain reconstructed-depth evidence. Point-to-raster correspondence uncertainty is reported per point.
No confirmatory threshold or Q dimension is decided by this catalog.
